A note from the maker
Built by someone
who kept guessing.
I’m an indie developer, not a designer. I’d find five colors I loved, put them in a real interface, and wonder why they didn’t feel right.
ColorVerse is the tool I wanted: a way to see a palette in your work before you commit. Your website, your slides, your next idea. If it feels right, take it and make something.
YigitINDEPENDENTLY MADE.
